description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama, Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the amendment of land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about a specific parcel of land (No. 18 of Block 01) including its location, cadastral map numbers, and amendments to the extent of ownership share. The content is signed by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement and falls under the "PART III - LANDS" section, making it clearly about land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 classification.
